Tests equivocation proof verification and shred chunk conversion logic.

# Purpose
This executable test file validates equivocation proof handling in the `fd_eqvoc` code path and the related shred chunk conversion logic. It builds an `fd_eqvoc_t` object, sets up the needed workspace and leader schedule, and uses fixed byte patterns to create `fd_shred_t` objects and duplicate-shred chunks. The tests call functions such as `fd_eqvoc_shreds_verify`, `fd_eqvoc_proof_from_chunks`, and `fd_eqvoc_proof_to_chunks` to check that shred pairs and chunk data produce the expected proof results and preserve the data layout. The cases cover identity input, payload changes, Merkle root changes, metadata changes, last-index violations, overlap cases, and chained-shred cases, and they verify results such as `FD_EQVOC_PROOF_VERIFY_FAILURE`, `FD_EQVOC_PROOF_VERIFY_SUCCESS_SIGNATURE`, `FD_EQVOC_PROOF_VERIFY_SUCCESS_META`, `FD_EQVOC_PROOF_VERIFY_SUCCESS_LAST`, and `FD_EQVOC_PROOF_VERIFY_SUCCESS_OVERLAP`.
